Subject: Exploring Middle-Grade Mystery Books for Representation

Hola Ana,

I wanted to recommend a selection of middle-grade mystery books written by Zoraida Córdova and other Latinx authors that I think would be an excellent addition to your classroom. These stories not only offer engaging plots but also provide cultural textures, rich family dynamics, and clever sleuths that your students will love.

What I find particularly exciting about these books is the way they weave cultural context into the narratives, often using family history and cultural traditions as clues to unravel the mystery. I think this will resonate deeply with your students, many of whom will see themselves reflected in the pages.

Some potential discussion topics that come to mind include how cultural context shapes motivation and how family history becomes a clue. These themes will not only spark interesting conversations but also provide a unique opportunity for your students to think critically about the ways in which culture influences our lives.

I'd be happy to pull a reading copy and a teacher guide excerpt for you to review. Would you like me to leave the materials in your mailbox for you to take a look? Alternatively, I'd be happy to meet with you to discuss further.

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts.

[Your Name]

Subject: New ILL Turnaround Expectations — Please Note

Dear Library Staff,

As you are aware, our partner libraries have adjusted their schedules, and we must adapt our interlibrary loan (ILL) service to meet the evolving needs of our patrons. To maintain the reliability of our ILL service and uphold our role as a bridge for patrons, we are introducing new turnaround expectations.

Going forward, our goal is to fulfill ILL requests within five business days when possible. To ensure transparency and facilitate patron engagement, please update request statuses promptly so patrons can follow progress. If a request will take longer than five business days, please notify the patron immediately.

To prioritize teacher- or curriculum-related requests, please utilize the priority flag. This will enable these requests to move up the queue and receive timely attention. To assist you in using this feature, I will be sending a short guide on how to flag requests.

Additionally, I will be hosting a 15-minute Q&A session tomorrow to address any questions you may have about these new expectations. I encourage you to attend and ask any questions you may have.

Please note that these changes are designed to enhance our ILL service and better support our patrons. If you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Subject: Updated Overdue Notice Schedule — Please Read

Dear Staff,

As circulation has increased, we need to nudge patrons to return materials more quickly to keep our stacks moving. To achieve this, we are updating our automatic notice schedule as follows:

- First notice will be sent 3 days after the due date.
- Second notice will be sent 14 days after the due date.
- Final notice will be sent 30 days after the due date and will include information on replacement costs.

In addition to these automatic notices, manual actions will be taken for high-demand items such as new releases and classroom sets. Immediate notices will be sent for these materials to ensure timely returns.

For first-time offenders, we will consider waiving the first late fee. If this waiver is granted, it will be noted in the patron's account.
